@testset "Frozen independent three-band THG benchmark" begin
    response=WannierNLQG.Responses
    q=Matrix(qr(ComplexF64[1 im 0.3; 0.2im 1 0.7; 0.4 0.2im 1]).Q)
    connection=q*Diagonal([-1.0, 0, 1])*q'
    commutator(a, b)=a*b-b*a
    workspace=response.ThirdHarmonicWorkspace(3)
    output=zeros(ComplexF64, 1, 1, 4, 2, 2)
    total=zeros(ComplexF64, 4, 2, 2)
    policy=response.HarmonicFrequencyPolicy(true, false, 0.06, 0.06, 0.0)
    for index in 0:127
        k=2pi*index/128
        energies=[-1.8+0.2cos(k), 0.15+0.35cos(k+0.4), 2+0.25sin(k)]
        first=Diagonal([-0.2sin(k), -0.35sin(k+0.4), 0.25cos(k)])
        second=Diagonal([-0.2cos(k), -0.35cos(k+0.4), -0.25sin(k)])
        b=zeros(ComplexF64, 3, 3, 3);
        c=zeros(ComplexF64, 3, 3, 3, 3)
        b[:, :, 1]=first-im*commutator(connection, Diagonal(energies))
        c[
            :,
            :,
            1,
            1,
        ]=second-2im*commutator(
            connection,
            first,
        )-commutator(connection, commutator(connection, Diagonal(energies)))
        data=(
            spectrum = (energies = energies,),
            internal_connection = zeros(ComplexF64, 3, 3, 3),
            hamiltonian_derivatives = b,
            hamiltonian_second_derivatives = c,
            internal_connection_derivatives = zeros(ComplexF64, 3, 3, 3, 3),
        )
        response.third_harmonic_response!(
            output,
            workspace,
            data,
            [0.37],
            [(1, 1, 1, 1)];
            fermi_energy = 0.1,
            temperature = 0.25/8.617333262145e-5,
            policy,
            eta_correction = false,
            degeneracy_threshold = 0.0,
            exact_occupations = true,
            formulation = :both,
        )
        total .+= output[1, 1, :, :, :]/128
    end
    # Theory note A.1: independent orbital density-matrix recursion/literal A4, Nk=512.
    reference=ComplexF64[
        -0.005603836740542179 + 0.021425343931478998im,
        0.0017283834722072412 - 0.002202526190982517im,
        0.03922688994872399 - 0.08272606230118257im,
        0.0800181578709567 + 0.15284562317961298im,
    ]
    @test isapprox(total[:, 1, 1], reference; atol = 3e-11, rtol = 3e-10)
    @test isapprox(sum(total[:, 1, 1]), sum(total[:, 1, 2]); atol = 3e-13, rtol = 3e-12)
    @test isapprox(
        total[:, 2, :],
        (im/(3complex(0.37, 0.06))) .* total[:, 1, :];
        atol = 3e-13,
        rtol = 3e-12,
    )
end
